description: Defines domain models, enums, and response models for the API related to content items, categories, and banners in an Android TV frontend project.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Domain model representing a content item displayed by the UI, including its name and poster image URL.

classes.name: HomeCategory
classes.description: Enum of supported home categories with their API path and user-facing title.

classes.name: BannerResponse
classes.description: Response data class for the banners API, containing a list of banner image URLs.

methods.name: HomeCategory
methods.description: Enum entries defining categories such as TRENDING, ACTION, DRAMA, etc., each with a path and title.
